label: Request platform (auth, rate limits, flags, logging)

doc: Only identified staff use the system; only approvers decide claims, and never their own.
An approver approves or rejects a submitted claim; nobody decides their own claim.
Finance exports approved claims for payout.
An employee looks up the claims they submitted.
An employee submits an expense claim.
An employee's request to be reimbursed for one expense.
The before_request hook that verifies the bearer token, and the requires_role decorator.
Whether the finance CSV export is switched on.
Requests per minute one principal may make to the claims-write policy.
Flags read from flags.yaml; a disabled flag answers 404 on its routes.
Structured JSON logs and one access-log line per request, for every route.
